text_block_list.text:
Let's go back in time a little to the
events right
after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has done it! She's won the
Triple Crown
just as she promised she
would!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, I don't know what to do with
myself!
Sorry, I'm just so excited! I'd
better calm down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a little. But still,
this is like a dream!
I can't
believe I've really reached the
peak.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong, I was aiming for it

whole-heartedly!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really did want to give everyone a
glorious
feeling of catharsis by taking
the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But even though I was doing my best, I
was afraid
I wouldn't be able to make it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks! And thanks for everything
you've
done too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We've worked hard, but the Twinkle
Series isn't
over yet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've won the Triple Crown,
people will
expect even more from me!
I'll have to start
training harder ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Will you trust in me and continue this
journey
alongside me?

She proffers her right hand cordially.
Without
hesitation, I take it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What a great response! Never
change,
Trainer. Never change!

Having fulfilled the miracle of winning
the Triple
Crown, we now must continue
running toward
even greater heights!
